D12.DECISION_CLOCK: NOT_APPLICABLE: identification card, not a predictive card. No decision time T; all quantities are realized-window descriptive profiles.
D12.FALSIFIER: US-transition mean A not above the pseudo-transition null (p >= 0.05), or sign-consistency below 7/10, or fewer than 3 positive years
FORBIDDEN_CLAIMS: which specific participants (ETFs, US institutions, equity traders) drive the shift
US equity session specifically (US macro-release times share the same clock)
any directional, return, or trading claim
any reinterpretation, rescue, or re-scoring of D11
generalization to other venues or assets
D12.FUNCTION: Identify whether the UTC timing of the intraday participation profile moves with the US clock
D12.HORIZON: W = 6 UTC days each side: Monday-Saturday before and Monday-Saturday after each transition Sunday. Amended pre-outcome from W=7: the EU fall transition is exactly the Sunday before the US fall transition in every year 2020-2024, so a 7-day BEFORE window lost that Sunday and broke weekday balance. Monday-Saturday windows keep weekday composition identical, exclude every transition Sunday, and hold the EU clock constant.
D12.INFORMATION_SOURCE: Statutory US and EU DST calendars (frozen dates below) + CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 1m quote_volume
D12.INTERPRETIVE_DEPENDENCY_NOT_RESCUE: D11 matched controls on UTC hour within year, which mixes different NY-clock positions across DST. D12 is informative for designing any future D11 confirmation, but its result must not be used to re-score, rescue, or reinterpret the consumed D11 RESULT.
D12.LEGAL_TIME_RANGE: UTC days 2020-01-01 .. 2024-12-31 inclusive. No 2025/2026 bar is opened.
D12.MATCHING_STRATA_IF_ANY: Monte Carlo pseudo-samples match the real delta mix (5 spring-type with delta=+1, 5 fall-type with delta=-1; adjusted to the eligible real mix)
D12.MECHANISM: BTC intraday participation is anchored to the US institutional wall clock (not UTC). If so, the UTC timing of the intraday quote-volume profile shifts by one hour exactly at US daylight-saving transitions, while the EU clock is held constant.
D12.MINIMUM_SUPPORT: Each window has 6 candidate days before missing-data filtering; a window is eligible iff at least 5 of its 6 days are included. At least 8 of 10 US transitions eligible; at least 100 eligible pseudo-transition Sundays (same 6+6 rule). Otherwise DEFERRED_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT. No window widening, no alternate W.
D12.NAME: PARTICIPATION_CLOCK_ANCHORING_DST_NATURAL_EXPERIMENT
D12.NEAREST_PRIOR_WORK: D3 (time-of-day as nuisance stratum), D11 (YEAR x WEEKDAY x UTC_HOUR matching; FOMC fixed on the NY clock), D7 (activity-level persistence)
D12.NO_LOOKAHEAD_RULE: Not predictive. Windows are symmetric realized intervals; no window crosses another region's transition day; pseudo-transition eligibility is determined by the calendar only, never by volume values.
D12.NULL_HYPOTHESIS: BTC participation timing is not US-clock anchored: mean A over US transitions is not larger than mean A over pseudo-transition draws with the same delta mix
D12.PRACTICAL_GATE_DIRECTION: A_k > 0 (predicted-direction alignment) in at least 7 of 10 eligible US transitions; scale-free sign-consistency gate
D12.PRIMARY_BASELINE: Pseudo-transition null: Every Sunday S that is not a US or EU transition day and whose Monday-Saturday windows S-6d..S-1d and S+1d..S+6d lie inside 2020-01-01..2024-12-31. Because every US and EU transition falls on a Sunday, no clock changes inside either window. For each pseudo Sunday compute A with delta=+1 and with delta=-1.
D12.PRIMARY_TARGET: CLOCK_ANCHORING_INDEX A_k for US transition k

PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION.HOURLY_VOLUME: v_d(h) = sum of 1m quote_volume in UTC hour h of UTC day d; an hour is complete iff all 60 minutes exist; a day is included iff all 24 hours are complete and sum_h v_d(h) > 0
PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION.INDEX: A_k = (D(0) - D(delta)) / D(0); ineligible if D(0) == 0
PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION.INTERPRETATION: A_k > 0 means the clock-predicted one-hour shift aligns the before/after profiles better than no shift
PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION.PREDICTED_SHIFT: delta = +1 at spring-forward (US clock moves one hour earlier in UTC), delta = -1 at fall-back
PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION.SHIFTED_DISTANCE: D(L) = sum over h=0..23 of (P_after(h) - P_before((h + L) mod 24))^2
PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION.WINDOWS: Every US transition is a Sunday S. BEFORE = UTC days S-6d..S-1d (Monday-Saturday immediately preceding S); AFTER = UTC days S+1d..S+6d (Monday-Saturday immediately following S). S itself is excluded. Both windows contain exactly one Monday..Saturday each (identical weekday composition), neither contains a US or EU transition day, and the EU clock is constant across both. Pseudo-transition Sundays use the identical construction.
PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION.WINDOW_PROFILE: P(h) = mean of s_d(h) over included days in the window (days weighted equally so no single day dominates)

D12.PROTECTED_BOUNDARY: Only 2020-01..2024-12 monthly parquet files are opened; the last AFTER window (2024-11-04..2024-11-09) ends before 2025-01-01.
D12.SEARCH_SURFACE: One observable (quote-volume share), one window length (weekday-matched Monday-Saturday W=6), one index, one primary contrast (US), one diagnostic (EU). No alternate observables (trade count, RV), no alternate W, no hour-subset selection.
D12.SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_CANNOT_CHANGE_CLASS: The identical statistic with the identical Monday-Saturday 6+6 windows around the 10 EU transitions (US clock constant inside every EU window). Reported; cannot promote or demote D12.
D12.SELECTOR: Each of the 10 US DST transition Sundays (primary) and each of the 10 EU transition Sundays (secondary diagnostic). Window days exclude any US or EU transition day.
D12.TEMPORAL_STABILITY_REQUIREMENT: Mean A over the transitions of a calendar year > 0 in at least 3 of 5 years (2020-2024)
D12.UNCERTAINTY_RULE: One-sided Monte Carlo: draw pseudo-samples of the same size and delta mix without replacement, N=10000, p = (1 + #{null mean >= observed}) / (1 + N), alpha = 0.05. Seed frozen in the next unit before any profile is computed.
D12.WHY_NOT_RESCUE: It asks which clock organizes participation; no prior card asked this. It uses no event outcome, no volatility level, no impact proxy, no FOMC date. It is not a D11 child: its design would be identical had D11 been null.

D13.NAME: CROSS_SECTIONAL_WEEKLY_RELATIVE_RETURN_STRUCTURE
D13.NEAREST_PRIOR_WORK: H05/B2-05 (BTC own flow -> BTC return), MARKET-05 / D4 / D10 (BTC-ETH two-asset only), Sprint03 C5 breadth candidate (not selected; panel absent)

D13.PRIMARY_TARGET: Weekly Spearman rank IC between formation return r_f = ln(C_T / C_{T-7d}) and holding return r_h = ln(C_{T+7d} / C_T) across the N eligible symbols
D13.PROTECTED_BOUNDARY: Only monthly files 2019-12..2024-12 are downloaded; listing keys naming 2025/2026 are never fetched; last holding week closes on or before 2024-12-29.
D13.SEARCH_SURFACE: One formation length, one holding length, one universe rule, one statistic, two-sided. No skip-week, no alternate horizons, no quantile-count sweep, no alternate liquidity windows.

SELECTOR.COMPLETENESS: Daily closes present at T - 7d and T
SELECTOR.EXCLUSIONS: Stablecoin/fiat base assets and leveraged-token bases (UP/DOWN/BULL/BEAR tokens verified by the existence of the stripped base) are excluded by a name-only list frozen in the next unit before any return is computed
SELECTOR.LIQUIDITY: Rank by trailing 28-day summed quote volume over days strictly before T; keep top N
SELECTOR.LISTING_AGE: First available daily candle at or before T - 35 days
SELECTOR.N_RULE: N = min(100, minimum over all decision Mondays of the count of symbols passing exclusions + listing age + completeness). Determined from counts only. If N < 20: DEFERRED_INSUFFICIENT_PANEL_SUPPORT.

D13.TEMPORAL_STABILITY_REQUIREMENT: Mean IC within a calendar year (by decision Monday) has the same sign as the pooled mean in at least 3 of 5 years (2020-2024)

TERMINAL_MARK_RULE.FULL_WEEK: Close of the candle opening at T+6d (price at T+7d)
TERMINAL_MARK_RULE.INTRAWEEK_DISAPPEARANCE: If the symbol trades during the holding week but has no candle opening at T+6d, the final observed close inside the holding week is the terminal mark
TERMINAL_MARK_RULE.LOOKUP_WINDOW: Only candles opening at T..T+6d are read for the terminal mark
TERMINAL_MARK_RULE.NO_POST_T_CLOSE: A symbol selected at T with no observed close in the holding week is NOT excluded, NOT assigned a zero return, and NOT marked with later relisting data. It is counted in NO_POST_T_CLOSE_SELECTED_N and scientific execution fails closed with DEFERRED_TERMINAL_MARK_UNRESOLVED unless the feasibility unit freezes a deterministic, point-in-time terminal-mark authority for every such case before outcomes
TERMINAL_MARK_RULE.UNIVERSE_MEMBERSHIP: Membership at T uses only information available through T; it is never conditioned on survival to T+7d

D13.UNCERTAINTY_RULE: Two-sided sign-flip Monte Carlo on the weekly IC series around 0, N=10000, alpha=0.05, p = (1 + #{|null mean| >= |observed|}) / (1 + N). Seed frozen in the next unit. Weekly ICs are non-overlapping; residual serial dependence is a declared limitation.
D13.WHY_NOT_RESCUE: First card with more than two assets and first market-neutral relative-return target. Not BTC-conditional scalar prediction, not 24h MAE, not a BTC-ETH substitute, not a flow/taker child.
